blurb: The Vista Lady was built in 1998 by Cecil Robbins in Cambridge Maryland is perfectly designed for fishing in Maryland’s bay waters. She is 40’ in length with a 13.5’ beam and powered by a 350 HP diesel Caterpillar. The design is known as a Chesapeake Bay deadrise and will fish 6 people with room to spare.
